# SCSC

SCSC stands for See. Capture. Share. Connect.

SCSC is a Cape Winelands photography business led by Sonia, offering warm, natural, on-location photography across Somerset West, Stellenbosch, Franschhoek, Strand, Gordon's Bay and Cape Town.

## Services

- Family & lifestyle photography
- Maternity and newborn lifestyle photography
- Kids' parties, birthdays and family celebrations
- Sports, schools, clubs and community events
- Winelands, wine-tour and tourism photography
- Personal branding and commercial content for local businesses

## Family session

Standard Family Story session: R1,495.
Launch-only Founding Five offer: R1,295 for the first five qualifying family bookings.
Typical duration: 60 minutes.
Typical delivery: 30–40 edited photographs via private online gallery.
Turnaround: 5–7 working days.
Booking deposit: 30% by EFT.
